title: Wingman — score and squadron ranking
description: Design 018: the score of every round from the end-of-round PERFORMANCE panel, by period, with a marker for each change that can affect play.

target.rawSql:
SELECT at AS time, label AS text, ref AS tags
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(at)
ORDER BY at

list.name: granularity
list.label: Granularity
list.description: The period each bar and table row covers (week: ISO, from Monday).

list.name: aggregate
list.label: Aggregate
list.query: sum : sum(x),mean : avg(x),median : percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x),count : count(x),min : min(x),max : max(x)
list.description: What each period shows of the metric over its read rounds.

list.name: metric
list.label: Metric
list.description: The figure from the PERFORMANCE panel.

list.name: window
list.label: Moving average
list.description: Read rounds in the moving average.

list.name: tags
list.label: Tags
list.description: A JSON object of tags to match; {} matches every round.

panels.title: Totals in range
panels.description: Wingman's own rounds over the time range: flown, read, and the score of the read ones. Rounds with a manual takeover are counted apart and left out of the rest. Compare means only where nearly every round was read.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE manual_takeovers = 0) AS "rounds flown",
       count(score) FILTER (WHERE manual_takeovers = 0) AS "rounds read",
       coalesce(sum(score) FILTER (WHERE manual_takeovers = 0), 0) AS "total score",
       round((avg(score) FILTER (WHERE manual_takeovers = 0))::numeric, 1) AS "mean per read round",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY score) FILTER (WHERE manual_takeovers = 0)
           AS "median per read round",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT manual_takeovers = 0) AS "rounds taken over"
FROM rounds
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb

panels.title: Squadron now
panels.description: Mobius Squadron's latest reading in the time range: its rank on the game's squadron leaderboard (lower is better), its trophies, and how long ago wingman read them in the lobby (ADR 166). The two squadron charts below draw every reading.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT read_at, rank, trophies
  FROM squadron_rankings
  WHERE $__timeFilter(read_at)
  ORDER BY read_at DESC
  LIMIT 1)
SELECT rank AS "rank", trophies AS "trophies", read_at AS "read"
FROM latest

panels.title: Score per round: wingman and manual takeover
panels.description: Every read round at the time it ended. Wingman's own rounds are dots, one colour per account (no account, a round rebuilt from a log that names none), with the mean of their last $window read rounds over all accounts (blue line); rounds with a manual takeover are orange, with their own moving average. The operator expects the takeover rounds to score higher, and the two lines to close as wingman improves (2026-10-29).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ended_at AS time,
       coalesce(tags->>'account', 'no account') AS metric,
       score AS value
FROM rounds
WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND manual_takeovers = 0 AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
ORDER BY 1

SELECT ended_at AS time,
       avg(score) OVER (ORDER BY ended_at ROWS BETWEEN ${window:raw} - 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "wingman, moving average"
FROM rounds
WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND manual_takeovers = 0 AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
ORDER BY 1

SELECT ended_at AS time,
       score AS "manual takeover",
       avg(score) OVER (ORDER BY ended_at ROWS BETWEEN ${window:raw} - 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "manual takeover, moving average"
FROM rounds
WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND NOT manual_takeovers = 0 AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Squadron rank per reading (lower is better)
panels.description: Mobius Squadron's place on the game's squadron leaderboard at each reading. Wingman reads it in the lobby between rounds (ADR 166). A lower number is a better place. It is the squadron's own figure, so it does not depend on the account that read it, and the tags box does not apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT read_at AS time, rank AS "rank"
FROM squadron_rankings
WHERE rank IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(read_at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Squadron trophies per reading
panels.description: Mobius Squadron's trophy count at each reading: the whole squadron's, every member included, not wingman's alone. It does not depend on the account that read it, and the tags box does not apply (ADR 166).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT read_at AS time, trophies AS "trophies"
FROM squadron_rankings
WHERE trophies IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(read_at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wingman by jet
panels.description: Wingman's own rounds by the jet on the lobby as PLAY was clicked (ADR 167), the best mean score first. Kills, deaths and assists are per round. ± 95% is the margin on the mean: trust a gap between two jets only when their ranges do not overlap. A jet with under 10 read rounds comes after the rest, because so few prove little. A jet can fly on several accounts; narrow to one with the tags box. Rounds flown before 2026-10-31 have no jet recorded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(tags->>'jet', 'not recorded') AS "Jet",
       count(*) AS "Rounds flown",
       count(score) AS "Rounds read",
       round(avg(score)) AS "Mean score",
       round(1.96 * stddev_samp(score) / sqrt(count(score))) AS "± 95%",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY score) AS "Median score",
       round(avg(kills), 1) AS "Kills",
       round(avg(deaths), 1) AS "Deaths",
       round(avg(assists), 1) AS "Assists"
FROM rounds
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND manual_takeovers = 0
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
GROUP BY tags->>'jet'
ORDER BY tags->>'jet' IS NULL, count(score) < 10, "Mean score" DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: ${aggregate:text} of $metric per $granularity
panels.description: The chosen aggregate over every read round that ended in each period (America/New_York). An unread round adds nothing; Rounds per period counts it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('$granularity', ended_at, '$tz') AS time,
       ${aggregate:raw} AS "${aggregate:text} of $metric"
FROM (SELECT ended_at, ${metric:raw} AS x
      FROM rounds
      WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND manual_takeovers = 0
        AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb) AS r
WHERE x IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rounds per $granularity
panels.description: Rounds read and not read in each period; together, the rounds flown.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('$granularity', ended_at, '$tz') AS time,
       count(score) AS "rounds read",
       count(*) - count(score) AS "rounds not read"
FROM rounds
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND manual_takeovers = 0
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Periods
panels.description: One row per $granularity: rounds flown and read, and the sum, mean, median, minimum and maximum of $metric over the read rounds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('$granularity', ended_at, '$tz') AS period,
       count(*) AS "rounds flown",
       count(score) AS "rounds read",
       sum(${metric:raw}) AS sum,
       round(avg(${metric:raw})::numeric, 1) AS mean,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ${metric:raw}) AS median,
       min(${metric:raw}) AS min,
       max(${metric:raw}) AS max
FROM rounds
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND manual_takeovers = 0
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Tags
panels.description: Each tag key and value among the rounds in range, with its count of rounds. Filter with the tags box, for example {"account": "mobius0"}.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.key AS tag, t.value, count(*) AS rounds
FROM rounds, jsonb_each_text(rounds.tags) AS t(key, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND manual_takeovers = 0
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
